claims: No. 8 seed Oregon defeated No. 9 seed Virginia Tech 70-60 in the 2026 NCAA Women's Basketball Tournament first round on March 20, 2026.
Katie Fiso led the Oregon Ducks with 22 points.
Carys Baker led the Virginia Tech Hokies with 21 points.
Oregon had a 23-12 record, notes Yahoo Sports.
Oregon advanced to the second round, notes Yahoo Sports.
Virginia Tech's season ended with a 23-10 record, notes Yahoo Sports.
Virginia Tech closed the gap to 32-29, says University of Oregon Athletics.
Oregon created a 22-point lead at one stage, says University of Oregon Athletics.
Katie Fiso scored 22 points on 9-of-12 shooting for Oregon, says Sports Illustrated.
Carys Baker led Virginia Tech with 21 points, notes Yahoo Sports.
Carleigh Wenzel was held to 9 points, notes Yahoo Sports.
Oregon advanced to play the winner of #1 Texas vs. #16 Missouri State, say the Oregon Ducks.
